task.title: Historical Phase L L4a/L5a recovery draft
task.objective: Preserve the interrupted recovery evidence. This combined draft is not the execution gate for ordinary direct-main product work: its declared Beads-only scope cannot truthfully represent the recovered cross-layer diff. Any later protected project-state operation must use its own task-specific contract and lease. L4a evidence is complete; L5a remains open because its current duration gate fails.

acceptance.description: The production collector, through the real ExecutionEngine, real Chromium and the real mock site, writes the captured evidence and a deterministic cause into the persisted report.json for every labelled scenario, excludes protected-login surfaces, survives cancellation and manual handoff, and releases every listener.
Capture ON versus OFF is measured against the proposed ceilings and the run path reaches no AI module. The current duration result does not satisfy the ceiling.
Every L4a family is covered by the engine rule table with Flow and Workflow parity and legacy profiles still validating.
Typecheck and bundles pass on the final state.

evidence.observed: 74/74 on the final state: 14 concurrent executions through the real engine; seven mutations (collector disconnected, response listener never attached, buffer dropping UI events, report omitting diagnostics, protected-login guard disabled, report written before a cancelled runner unwinds, listeners never detached) each caught.

13 PASS / 2 FAIL on the current six paired development-host rounds: +326 ms fast median versus a +193.4 ms limit and +380 ms evidence median versus a +341.6 ms limit. Node CPU (+122.5 ms per instance), 3.7 KB evidence, listener and Chromium cleanup, and no-AI import closure passed. Limits remain proposed and unapproved.

94/94; verify:validation 163/163, verify:legacy-compat 152/152, verify:branch-pairs 40/40, verify:wait-validation 107/107 and verify:assertion-validation 77/77 after correcting four fixtures that bound a runtime input without a key.
tsc --noEmit and electron-vite build passed on the final product state.
138/138 preserved broad GUI checks plus 16/16 focused loop-capsule checks; the focused suite completed durable reload, history and accessibility paths.

completion.qa_basis: L4a family, compatibility and full GUI evidence pass. L5a real-browser capture, persistence, privacy and cleanup pass, but its required duration gate is currently failing and therefore cannot be represented as complete.
completion.qa_known_limitations: This preserved combined draft is not used as a direct-main product-work gate. A later task-specific project-state contract is required to close a Beads item. L5a requires an engineering correction or explicit default-policy decision, a passing rerun, and then owner approval of a release ceiling. L1 real-model gates remain BLOCKED by the missing approved runtime/model pack. No independent QC review was run.
